about: Independent labelled set for pronoun ROLE checking (reviewer-written, native reading). own/other = what the speaker calls themself / the listener. label: ok = every pronoun plays the role the line needs; error = at least one pronoun is in the wrong role. wrong = [word (lower case), nth case-insensitive whole-word occurrence] of each pronoun in the wrong role. origin: composed (reviewer) or bench:<scene>#n / user (the reported case). Pairs: Sera em->anh Ren; Ren anh->em Sera; Aoi chị->em Yuto; Yuto em->chị Aoi; Chiyo bà->cháu Minato; Minato cháu->bà; Mori cô->em Mio; Mio em->cô; Kenta tao->mày; Mark tôi->anh Daniel; Daniel em->anh Mark.
